findings.summary: The stage predicate has no curl-of-potential clause for the wave or the mean. It keeps exact per-mode solenoidality, total and base divergence-free, and the moments. The curl representations are proved separately in realization files.
The (9.8) bound on E_θ, E_z is stored on the good mean residual (Gaussian and alias means subtracted). raw_mean_bounds recovers the exact thetaResidual and axialResidual in MeanClass (1+σ).

The Lean predicate adds p_w ∈ W_1, covariance ∈ M_1, flat Gaussian and alias families, primitive moving-support data, chart coherence and torus periodicity. It is proved at every stage by state_runInvariant.

Supports are imposed on the stored block, Gaussian and alias input coefficients, not on the residual source coefficients f_{γ,m} of Prop. 9.3(i). Residual support is derived, since the residual is computed locally from the block.

The closing 'Consequently' sentence is not a field. It is similarity_identity, with flatness of the remainder from current_pressureAlias_class. The auditor's recovery argument cited axisFlat, which bounds the accumulated alias instead.

The auditor left the normalization of G_wave unchecked. The Lean residual is the chart residual, equal to Q^(2A+1/2) times the physical one; residualBlock is its per-label nonzero-harmonic part with Gaussian and alias coefficients removed.
